story: Sara and Ivan look at the animals and the weather during different seasons. They see a tiger, a pig, a horse, and an elephant. They watch the changing sky and the beautiful nature.
title: Nature and Seasons
setting: A beautiful landscape with a river and farm animals.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: a young girl with long brown hair and a yellow shirt

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: a young boy with short black hair and blue overalls

sentences.en: The sun is in the blue sky.
sentences.scene_prompt: The sun is in a clear blue sky.

sentences.en: A large tiger walks near the river.
sentences.scene_prompt: A large orange tiger with black stripes walks near a blue river.

sentences.en: Ivan sees a small pink pig.
sentences.zh: 伊万看到一只粉色的小猪。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan, a boy in blue overalls, looks at a small pink pig.

sentences.en: A big horse runs in the spring.
sentences.scene_prompt: A brown horse runs through green grass and colorful flowers in spring.

sentences.en: The sky is cloudy and rainy today.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dark clouds fill the sky and rain falls on the ground.

sentences.en: Sara sees a grey elephant and a flower.
sentences.zh: 萨拉看到一只灰色的象和一朵花。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara, a girl in a yellow shirt, looks at a grey elephant and a red flower.

sentences.en: A star is in the winter sky.
sentences.zh: 一颗星星在冬天的天空里。
sentences.scene_prompt: A single star is in the dark night sky during winter.

sentences.en: Every animal is in the park.
sentences.scene_prompt: A tiger, a pig, and an elephant are all in a green park.

sentences.en: They use warm clothes in the winter.
sentences.zh: 他们在冬天使用温暖的衣服。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara and Ivan wear heavy jackets and warm clothes in the snow.
